lines.written: It's getting hard to breathe. Shouldn't we tell someone?
lines.said: It's getting hard to breathe... Shouldn't we tell someone?

lines.written: Relax. If it was dangerous, somebody would say so.
lines.said: Relax. If it was dangerous, somebody would say so.

lines.written: Now he has said it is fine. Leaving would mean admitting he was wrong.
lines.said: Now, he has said it is fine. Leaving would mean admitting... he was wrong.

lines.written: My eyes are burning. Is nobody going to move?
lines.said: My eyes are burning! Is nobody going to move?

lines.written: What do you think he does?
lines.said: What do you think... he does?

lines.written: They are all calm. I must be the one who is wrong.
lines.said: They are all calm... I must be the one, who is wrong.
